summary: SIPRO Batch 1 Frontend Testing (6 scenarios): FE-B (Material dropdown), FE-I (Unit edit/delete guards), FE-J (Phase edit/delete guards), FE-K (CoA edit with journal guards), FE-N (Lead dropdown + anti-duplicate), FE-O (QC Template CRUD). Backend 100% PASS (iteration 27). Testing completed with 4/6 scenarios fully passed, 2 scenarios with critical bugs found, 1 scenario blocked by missing Master Data access.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog overlay intercepts click on edit button after adding material - requires force=True or closing dialog first
ui_bugs.workaround: Use force=True on click or close add dialog before editing

critical_bugs.issue: Delete button ([data-testid='unit-delete-btn']) appears on BOOKED unit A-01 - should ONLY appear on available units per business rules
critical_bugs.business_impact: Users can accidentally delete booked units which are tied to transactions, violating data integrity
critical_bugs.fix_needed: Conditional rendering should check: {u.status === 'available' ? <Button data-testid='unit-delete-btn'...> : null}

critical_bugs.issue: Delete phase button ([data-testid='phase-delete-btn']) is DISABLED on 'Finishing' phase with progress=0 - should be ENABLED per business rules (only phases with progress > 0 should be locked)
critical_bugs.business_impact: Users cannot delete phases with 0 progress that were created by mistake
critical_bugs.investigation_needed: Line 54 logic appears correct: const deletable = Number(phase?.progress || 0) === 0; Verify 'Finishing' phase actually has progress=0 in database or if denormalization issue exists

deployment_issues.issue: Super Admin quick login button missing from /login page - only 6 buttons visible (Owner, Manajer, Sales, Finance, Proyek, Masuk). Manual login with superadmin@sipro.co.id works but /master-data route and Master Data menu not accessible even with Super Admin role
deployment_issues.impact: Cannot test FE-O scenario - Master Data functionality completely inaccessible
deployment_issues.note: All URLs redirect to dashboard with no tabs. No Admin/Master Data menu item in sidebar even for Super Admin role

technical_notes.reference_select_implementation: ReferenceSelect component correctly implements BUTTON role='combobox' pattern (not native <select>). Options rendered as [role='option'] in portal after trigger click. Verified working in FE-B (Material UOM) and FE-N (Lead Source/Unit Type).

✅ Phase delete disabled when progress > 0 (FE-J - 'Struktur' phase)
✅ CoA type locked when used in journal entries (FE-K - Bank account)

technical_notes.sse_handling: App uses SSE (EventSource) so wait_until='networkidle' not reliable. Used wait_until='domcontentloaded' + specific selectors.
